verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken structure: the left half is an empty blurred background with no product on it, the coffee bag (the hero) is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail next to the logo at the bottom, the CTA sits above the headline so the reading order is reversed, and the SAVE 15% badge floats on its own. A is slightly worse because its headline starts further left than the body copy and breaks as 'Your coffee, on / repeat', leaving a near-orphan. B's 'Your coffee, / on repeat' wraps naturally and lines up with the body copy.
